content.logline: A desperate Three Kingdoms general leads his exhausted infantry on a perilous hand-over-hand mountain climb to launch a devastating surprise foot-assault and break a deadly siege.

cast.name: General Zhao
cast.profile: A fiercely loyal, battle-hardened commander of the Vanguard forces, known for leading from the front.
cast.motivation: To save his besieged comrades in the valley below, no matter the personal cost.
cast.flaw: Dangerously uncompromising; he expects his men to endure the same lethal risks he willingly takes.

cast.name: Lieutenant Wei
cast.profile: A pragmatic and weary junior officer who serves as Zhao's voice of reason and the barometer for the men's morale.
cast.motivation: To keep his brothers-in-arms alive through an impossible mission.
cast.flaw: Prone to doubt when the odds seem mathematically insurmountable.

locations.name: Black Ridge Pass
locations.description: A vertical, ice-slicked mountain cliff face battered by howling winds. It is considered entirely impassable by military forces.

locations.name: Valley Siege Camp
locations.description: A massive, heavily fortified enemy encampment situated at the base of the mountain, heavily guarding the front but leaving the rear cliff-face exposed.

story_arc.summary: General Zhao halts his vanguard at the base of Black Ridge Pass, realizing the only way to reach the besieged city in time is to leave their horses behind and climb the sheer cliffs on foot.
story_arc.conflict: The men are exhausted, and scaling the mountain without gear seems like a suicide mission.
story_arc.turning_point: Zhao abandons his own armor and mount, striking the rock face bare-handed to lead by example.

story_arc.summary: Mid-climb, the howling mountain winds and ice test the infantry's limits; a frayed rope snaps, nearly sending a dozen men to their deaths.
story_arc.conflict: Gravity, freezing temperatures, and failing equipment threaten to wipe out the vanguard before they ever see battle.
story_arc.turning_point: Zhao catches the falling lifeline, his hands bleeding against the stone, holding the weight long enough for the men to secure a new hold.

story_arc.summary: Surviving the descent, Zhao's infantry emerges from the shadows of the cliff and launches a brutal, silent foot-assault on the unguarded rear of the siege camp.
story_arc.conflict: Zhao's men are vastly outnumbered and fighting strictly on foot against an entrenched, armored enemy.
story_arc.turning_point: The sheer shock of heavily armed infantry emerging from an 'impassable' mountain throws the enemy camp into a total, chaotic rout, breaking the siege.

scene_outline.goal: Zhao must convince his exhausted soldiers to abandon their horses and climb the vertical cliff.
scene_outline.conflict: Lieutenant Wei argues that the men will freeze or fall, insisting they take the long route, which will be too late.
scene_outline.turn: Zhao strips off his heavy commander's mantle and begins climbing the ice-slicked rock solo, forcing his men's loyalty to overcome their fear.

scene_outline.goal: The vanguard must survive the treacherous hand-over-hand ascent through howling winds.
scene_outline.conflict: A jagged rock slices a primary climbing rope; Wei and several soldiers slip, dangling precariously over the abyss.
scene_outline.turn: Zhao wedges himself into a crevice and grabs the fraying rope bare-handed, enduring immense pain to pull his lieutenant up over the ledge.

scene_outline.goal: Break the enemy siege by attacking the camp's vulnerable rear.
scene_outline.conflict: They have no cavalry, no heavy armor, and are facing a massive army; they must rely entirely on shock and hand-to-hand savagery.
scene_outline.turn: Zhao leads a screaming infantry charge out of the mountain fog, tossing torches into the enemy tents; the enemy panics at the impossible ambush and the siege lines collapse.
